consent.title: Privacy Notice & Consent
consent.subtitle: Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019
consent.intro: PressSafe is committed to protecting your personal data in compliance with the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019. Please read the following carefully before proceeding.
consent.dataCollectedDesc: We collect your name, email, and optionally your phone number to provide our services. Evidence and incident reports you submit are encrypted and stored securely.
consent.dataPurposeDesc: Your data is used solely to provide verification, evidence vault, and safety reporting services. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties without your explicit consent.
consent.dataRetentionDesc: You may request deletion of your account and data at any time. We will process deletion requests within 30 days.
consent.yourRightsDesc: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data. Contact us at privacy@presssafe.io.
consent.checkboxLabel: I have read and agree to the PressSafe Privacy Notice and consent to the processing of my personal data as described.
